title: Self-duality of massless scalar three-point amplitudes
summary: We prove that off-shell massless scalar three-point Feynman integrals are self-dual under Fourier transformation. This implies that a momentum space integral can be expressed as the position space integral of the same Feynman graph with transformed edge-weights (not the dual graph) if external vertices are labeled accordingly. In particular, any off-shell massless scalar three-point Feynman integral can be expressed as a graphical function. The result follows immediately from a theorem by M. Golz, E.
